text: Appeal of Order to Comply (March 29, 2022) for 168 Eileen Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (March 29, 2022) for 168 Eileen Avenue, Folder No. 22 127730 PRS 00 IV, and, in doing so, granted and extension of time to August 31, 2022.
